title: Complex Frequency as Generalized Eigenvalue
summary: This paper shows that the concept of complex frequency, originally introduced to characterize the dynamics of signals with complex values, constitutes a generalization of eigenvalues when applied to the states of linear time-invariant (LTI) systems.
